scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n tools,config,server,frontend,backend -c magenta,yellow,cyan,blue,green "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/tools-cesium" "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/sample-config" "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/server" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n tools,config,server,backend -c magenta,yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/tools-cesium" "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/sample-config" "npm run dev -w @cesium-ai/server" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cesium-ai/tools-cesium && npm run build -w @cesium-ai/sample-config && npm run build -w @cesium-ai/server
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
